args.CodeContent:
# Offline Password Manager Web App

An offline, zero-backend, zero-network password manager built with React and Vite. All sensitive data is encrypted using AES-GCM (256-bit) via the browser's native Web Crypto API and stored strictly on the user's device in IndexedDB.

## User Review Required

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **No Backend & Zero Network Policy**:
> All cryptographic operations (PBKDF2 key derivation and AES-256-GCM encryption/decryption) and storage happen locally inside the browser. No data ever leaves the user's machine. All dependencies (icons, fonts, styles) will be bundled locally without CDN links.

> [!NOTE]
> **Recommended Workspace Directory**:
> The project will be initialized in `C:\Users\vijay\.gemini\antigravity\scratch\offline-password-manager`. After setup, you can set this folder as your active workspace if desired.

## Proposed Architecture & Security Design

```mermaid
graph TD
    User([User]) -->|Enters Master Password| Crypto[Web Crypto API]
    Crypto -->|PBKDF2 SHA-256 + 100k iters| MasterKey[AES-256-GCM CryptoKey (In-Memory Only)]
    MasterKey -->|Encrypt Payload + Random 12B IV| EncryptedData[Encrypted Blob]
    EncryptedData -->|Store locally| IDB[(Browser IndexedDB)]
    IDB -->|Load Encrypted Blob| Decrypt[AES-GCM Decrypt]
    MasterKey --> Decrypt
    Decrypt -->|Plaintext in RAM| VaultUI[React Vault UI]
    User -->|Lock / Inactivity Timeout| ClearMemory[Purge MasterKey from RAM]
```

### 1. Cryptography Specification (Web Crypto API)
- **Key Derivation**: PBKDF2 with SHA-256, 100,000 iterations, and a unique 16-byte cryptographically secure random salt (`crypto.getRandomValues`).
- **Encryption**: AES-GCM 256-bit with unique 12-byte initialization vector (IV) per record.
- **Verification Canary**: A small known encrypted token `{"canary": "vault-valid"}` to verify master password validity upon unlock without storing password hashes.
- **Memory Safety**: Master key and decrypted passwords are kept only in React component state (volatile RAM) while unlocked, and completely discarded on Lock or window reload.

### 2. Storage Schema (IndexedDB)
- Database name: `offline_password_manager`
- Object stores:
  - `meta`: Holds the vault salt, encrypted verification canary, and user preferences (auto-lock timer duration).
  - `vault_items`: Stores records with metadata and encrypted fields:
    - `id`: UUID
    - `title`: Plaintext / indexed for fast search or encrypted (we will encrypt all sensitive fields: username, password, url, notes; title can be optionally obscured or encrypted).
    - `category`: `logins` | `cards` | `notes`
    - `iv`: Base64 initialization vector
    - `ciphertext`: Base64 AES-GCM encrypted payload
    - `favorite`: Boolean
    - `updatedAt`: ISO timestamp

## Proposed Changes

### Project Scaffolding
- Location: `C:\Users\vijay\.gemini\antigravity\scratch\offline-password-manager`
- Build Tool: Vite + React (JavaScript/Tailwind CSS or clean modern responsive CSS)
- Zero external network assets (fonts and icons will be bundled locally via `lucide-react`)

---

### Core Security & Data Layer

#### [NEW] `src/services/crypto.js`
- `generateSalt(byteLength)`
- `deriveMasterKey(password, salt)`
- `encryptPayload(data, key)`
- `decryptPayload(encryptedObj, key)`
- `generateStrongPassword(options)` (cryptographically secure random values)

#### [NEW] `src/services/db.js`
- Pure native IndexedDB wrapper (`openDB`, `getMeta`, `setMeta`, `getAllItems`, `saveItem`, `deleteItem`, `clearAll`). Zero third-party runtime storage dependencies.

#### [NEW] `src/context/VaultContext.jsx`
- Vault state management:
  - `status`: `'uninitialized'` | `'locked'` | `'unlocked'`
  - `items`: Decrypted credentials list in memory
  - `autoLockMinutes`: Configurable auto-lock (e.g. 5m, 15m, 30m, never)
  - `lockVault()`: Immediately nullifies key and decrypted items from state
  - `unlockVault(masterPassword)`
  - `setupVault(masterPassword)`
  - `changeMasterPassword(oldPassword, newPassword)`
  - `exportEncryptedBackup()`: Download encrypted JSON backup
  - `importBackup(backupData, password)`

---

### User Interface Components

#### [NEW] `src/components/UnlockScreen.jsx`
- Vault setup (first-time user) with confirmation and strength indicator.
- Vault unlock screen with master password input and error shake animation.

#### [NEW] `src/components/Navbar.jsx`
- Search bar with instant filtering.
- Quick action: "Add Item", "Password Generator", "Settings", "Lock Vault" button with status indicator.

#### [NEW] `src/components/Sidebar.jsx`
- Category filters: All Items, Logins, Secure Notes, Cards, Favorites.
- Password Health audit indicator (counts weak / reused passwords).

#### [NEW] `src/components/ItemList.jsx` & `ItemCard.jsx`
- Interactive card/row list with one-click copy for username and password.
- Visual mask for passwords with click-to-reveal toggle.
- Edit and delete actions.

#### [NEW] `src/components/ItemModal.jsx`
- Form for adding/editing items:
  - Category picker
  - Title, URL, Username/Email, Password (with inline generator toggle & strength meter)
  - Notes field
  - Star / Favorite toggle

#### [NEW] `src/components/PasswordGeneratorModal.jsx`
- Dedicated generator with controls for length (8-64), uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols, and avoid ambiguous characters.
- One-click copy with copy confirmation toast.

#### [NEW] `src/components/SettingsModal.jsx`
- Change Master Password (re-encrypts entire vault).
- Auto-lock timer configuration.
- Export Encrypted Vault (JSON file).
- Import Encrypted Vault (merge or restore).
- Reset Vault (wipe IndexedDB).

#### [NEW] `src/components/SecurityAuditModal.jsx`
- Audit screen highlighting weak passwords (under 12 chars, no symbols/numbers) and reused passwords across different accounts.

## Verification Plan

### Automated / Functional Verification
1. **Crypto Unit & Integration Check**:
   - Verify encryption produces ciphertext that fails decryption with an incorrect password.
   - Verify decryption produces exact original payload with the correct master password.
2. **IndexedDB Persistence Check**:
   - Save credentials, reload page, verify items remain locked and encrypted in IndexedDB.
   - Unlock with master password and verify items restore correctly.
3. **Zero Network Calls Verification**:
   - Inspect browser DevTools Network tab while operating the app (adding, editing, generating, exporting) to ensure 0 HTTP/HTTPS requests are dispatched.
4. **Auto-Lock Verification**:
   - Verify vault locks automatically on inactivity or upon clicking the Lock button, clearing sensitive items from memory.

### Manual Verification
- Test end-to-end user journey: Setup master password -> Add entries -> Generate secure passwords -> Copy to clipboard -> Lock & Unlock -> Export backup -> Import backup.

# Offline Password Manager

A secure, 100% offline password manager web application built with React, the browser's native **Web Crypto API**, and **IndexedDB**.

---

## Key Features

- **100% Offline & Zero Network Calls**: Strict Content Security Policy (`connect-src 'none'`). All dependencies, icons, and styles are bundled locally. No servers, no tracking, no analytics.
- **Client-Side Cryptography**:
  - **Key Derivation**: PBKDF2 with SHA-256 and 100,000 iterations using a cryptographically random 16-byte salt (`crypto.getRandomValues`).
  - **Encryption**: Authenticated AES-GCM 256-bit with unique 12-byte initialization vectors (IV) for every credential record.
  - **Zero-Knowledge Auth**: Master password validity is verified against a canary token (`__OFFLINE_VAULT_CANARY_OK__`). No password hash is ever stored.
- **Persistent Local Storage**: Pure native IndexedDB wrapper (`OfflinePasswordManagerDB`) storing only encrypted ciphertexts and IVs.
- **Memory Protection**: Master encryption keys are stored exclusively in volatile JavaScript runtime memory and purged immediately upon locking or session inactivity.
- **Auto-Lock Timer**: Detects inactivity (mouse, keyboard, touch) and automatically locks the vault after a configurable timeout (default 15 minutes).
- **Security Health Audit**: Scans vault credentials for weak passwords (< 12 characters) and reused passwords across multiple accounts.
- **Built-in Password Generator**: Cryptographically secure random password generator with customizable length (8-64), character sets (uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols), and option to avoid ambiguous characters.
- **Encrypted Backup & Restore**: Export your vault as an encrypted `.json` file to safely back up across devices. Restore and merge backups using the backup's master password.

---

## Project Structure

```
offline-password-manager/
├── index.html                     # Vite entry HTML with strict zero-network CSP
├── offline-vault.html             # Completely self-contained single-file offline edition
├── package.json                   # Vite & React dependencies
├── vite.config.js                 # Vite bundler configuration
├── README.md                      # Documentation & security architecture
└── src/
    ├── main.jsx                   # React application mount
    ├── App.jsx                    # Root vault application & modal management
    ├── index.css                  # Self-contained dark-mode cybersecurity design system
    ├── services/
    │   ├── crypto.js              # PBKDF2 & AES-GCM Web Crypto API implementation
    │   ├── db.js                  # Native IndexedDB wrapper (meta & vault_items stores)
    │   └── generator.js           # Secure random generator & password entropy evaluator
    ├── context/
    │   └── VaultContext.jsx       # Global vault state, encryption, auto-lock & sync
    └── components/
        ├── Icons.jsx              # Pure SVG icon components (zero external icon fonts/CDNs)
        ├── UnlockScreen.jsx       # Vault setup & master password unlock interface
        ├── Navbar.jsx             # Top bar with live search, lock, and quick actions
        ├── Sidebar.jsx            # Category navigation (Logins, Cards, Notes, Favorites)
        ├── ItemList.jsx           # Filtered credential grid / list
        ├── ItemCard.jsx           # Credential card with one-click copy and visibility toggles
        ├── ItemModal.jsx          # Add / edit credential modal with inline generator
        ├── PasswordGeneratorModal.jsx # Standalone password generation tool
        ├── SettingsModal.jsx      # Auto-lock configuration, password change, backup/restore
        ├── SecurityAuditModal.jsx # Weak and duplicate password detector
        └── Toast.jsx              # Transient notification system
```

---

## How to Run

### Option 1: Double-Click Standalone Edition (No Node/npm required)
Open `offline-vault.html` in any modern web browser (Edge, Chrome, Firefox, Brave). It runs immediately with 100% offline capabilities and zero installation steps.

### Option 2: Vite React Development Server
If you have Node.js installed:
```bash
# 1. Install dependencies
npm install

# 2. Start the local development server
npm run dev
```
Then visit `http://localhost:3000` in your browser.

---

## Security Guarantees
1. **Zero External Data Flow**: No credentials, metadata, or telemetry are ever sent over a network.
2. **Encrypted at Rest**: All sensitive fields (passwords, usernames, URLs, notes, card numbers) are stored as AES-GCM ciphertexts inside IndexedDB.
3. **Volatile Key Lifespan**: Once locked, the master key is destroyed in RAM. A page refresh or tab close immediately locks the vault.

Transform the offline password manager into a native **Chrome/Edge Browser Extension (Manifest V3)** with in-page credential auto-fill and quick-copy overlays on websites like GitHub, Google, and more.

## User Review Required

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Zero-Network Policy Maintained**:
> The extension will continue to enforce `connect-src 'none'` in its extension Content Security Policy. No network calls, telemetry, or external API connections will be allowed. All AES-256 encryption and storage remain 100% local inside the browser extension sandbox (`chrome.storage.local`).

> [!NOTE]
> **Easy Loading in Chrome / Edge**:
> Chrome and Edge allow loading local extensions with one click via `chrome://extensions` > "Developer mode" > **"Load unpacked"**. No Web Store approval or purchase is necessary.

---

## Architecture & Workflows

```mermaid
graph TD
    subgraph Browser Extension Sandbox
        Popup[Toolbar Popup UI] --> Crypto[Web Crypto API AES-GCM]
        Crypto --> Storage[(chrome.storage.local)]
        Background[background.js Service Worker] --> Storage
    end

    subgraph Web Page (e.g. GitHub)
        ContentScript[content.js Injected Script]
        Inputs[Login & Password Inputs]
        OverlayUI[Floating Shield / Autofill Dropdown]
    end

    Inputs -->|Focus/Click| ContentScript
    ContentScript -->|chrome.runtime.sendMessage| Background
    Background -->|Get matching domain creds| ContentScript
    ContentScript -->|Render popup badge| OverlayUI
    OverlayUI -->|Click 'Auto-Fill' or 'Copy'| Inputs
```

---

## Proposed Changes

We will build the extension in a dedicated directory:
`C:\Users\vijay\.gemini\antigravity\scratch\offline-vault-extension`

### 1. Extension Manifest & Core Configuration

#### [NEW] `manifest.json`
- Manifest V3 compliant.
- Permissions: `["storage", "activeTab", "scripting"]`.
- Host permissions: `["<all_urls>"]` (needed to detect login inputs on sites like `github.com`).
- Strict zero-network Content Security Policy (`connect-src 'none';`).
- Declares popup, background service worker, and content scripts.

---

### 2. Cryptographic & Storage Layer

#### [NEW] `crypto.js`
- PBKDF2 (100,000 iterations, SHA-256) + AES-GCM 256-bit encryption using native Web Crypto API.
- Canary verification token for zero-knowledge master password authentication.

#### [NEW] `storage.js`
- Wrapper around `chrome.storage.local` for storing encrypted vault items, salt, canary, and settings.

---

### 3. Background Service Worker & Message Hub

#### [NEW] `background.js`
- Coordinates communication between web page content scripts and the vault.
- Maintains in-memory session unlock state and inactivity timer.
- Domain matcher: extracts current tab hostname (e.g., `github.com`) and matches against saved URLs in the vault.

---

### 4. In-Page Auto-Fill & Overlay (`github.com`, etc.)

#### [NEW] `content.js`
- Monitors input elements on web pages for username (`type="text"`, `type="email"`, `name="login"`, `id="login_field"`) and password (`type="password"`).

- When clicked:

    - **"Auto-Fill" button**: Automatically fills username & password and dispatches standard DOM events (`input`, `change`) so the site accepts the credentials.
    - **"Copy" button**: Copies password to clipboard without filling.

#### [NEW] `content.css`
- Scoped styling for the floating badge and dropdown to prevent conflicts with host website CSS.

---

### 5. Extension Popup UI

#### [NEW] `popup.html` & `popup.js`
- Clean, compact dark-mode popup that opens when clicking the extension icon in the Chrome/Edge toolbar.
- Shows master password setup or unlock screen.
- When unlocked:

#### [NEW] `icons/`
